sloka: आविवेश महाहर्षो देवानां चारणैः सह ।रावणे निहते रौद्रे सर्वलोकभयङ्करे ।। ६.१११.३० ।।
transliteration: āviveśa mahāharṣo devānāṁ cāraṇaiḥ saha ।rāvaṇe nihate raudre sarvalokabhayaṅkare ।। 6.111.30 ।।

translations.english: The gods too praised Sri Rama, the great soul saying, 'Well done, Well done', from the heaven, which was distinctly heard.
